name: comprehension-gate
description: Have the coding agent record what it changed and why — docstrings on the code, an immutable note for any change that is more than mechanical — and name a path's notes as it is read or edited

interface.shortDescription: Record why the code changed, and be told what is on record as it is read or edited.
interface.longDescription: Comprehension Gate asks the coding agent to leave docstrings on what it changed and an immutable note on what the change was for -- a purely mechanical change needs none -- derives the branch's change set from git to list the paths no note records yet, and names the notes covering a path, with their titles, as the agent reads or edits it. It never blocks a tool or holds a turn.
interface.defaultPrompt: List the changed paths on this branch that no note records yet, then write the missing docstrings and notes.
